answer: The current allowlisted package contains 14 files, 97075 uncompressed bytes, against a 10485760-byte ceiling (headroom 10388685). Every member is listed under current_package.entries. The gate is green on that zip and red on planted .git, an over-budget payload.bin, a transcript jsonl, a .log, and a credential-shaped .env name (contents not printed).

evidence.claim: Live pack of the deny-by-default allowlist was enumerated from the zip members; disk selection and archive names agree.

A zip with planted .git members fails git-dir; a zip whose total uncompressed size exceeds the declared budget fails size-ceiling and names the largest member; a clean fixture passes. Disabling the git-dir rule makes the planted zip stop firing that rule.
evidence.detail: archive-not-tree: .git was injected into the zip, not inferred from the worktree (this worktree has no .git).
